## Intrusion Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results


November 12, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s201.q4cdn.com/653989727/files/doc_news/Intrusion-Inc--Reports-Third-Quarter-2026-Results-2026.pdf)


Revenue growth reflects first full quarter of VigilAigent contribution and continued stabilization of the legacy business


**PLANO, TX /[ACCESS Newswire](https://www.accessnewswire.com/) / November 12, 2026 /** Intrusion Inc. (NASDAQ:INTZ) ("Intrusion" or the "Company"), a provider of AI-powered cyberattack prevention, threat intelligence, and managed cybersecurity solutions, announced today financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


**Recent Financial & Business Highlights:**


- Achieved sequential and year-over-year revenue growth of 84% and 36%, respectively, reflecting the $0.8 million contribution from the recent VigilAigent acquisition and continued stabilization of Intrusion's legacy business.
- Implemented additional cost-reduction initiatives, including headcount reductions and the voluntary exchange of management and Board cash compensation for equity, to streamline operations and improve cost efficiency while ensuring the Company maintains the resources necessary to pursue longer-term growth opportunities.
- Completed a $4.0 million debt-for-equity exchange in October which, together with other recent capital actions, increased stockholders' equity to more than $5.0 million and allowed the Company to secure an additional 180-day extension from Nasdaq to regain compliance with the minimum bid price requirement.


"Our third quarter results represent an important step forward for Intrusion as we continued to stabilize our business, integrate VigilAigent's capabilities with our existing platform, and execute on our growth strategy. Revenue in our legacy business approached prior-year levels, driven primarily by our contract with the State of Texas. Additionally, VigilAigent contributed its first full quarter of revenue since the acquisition, further strengthening our overall revenue run rate," said Tony Scott, President & Chief Executive Officer of Intrusion. "We are also encouraged by the quality of opportunities currently developing in our pipeline, including opportunities to expand our existing partnerships and government relationships and grow in new markets. We believe that these opportunities could meaningfully support future sustainable revenue growth."


Mr. Scott concluded, "Our focus remains on growing recurring revenue, expanding our commercial reach, and continuing to build a stronger platform that delivers AI-driven cybersecurity solutions to address the evolving threats facing our customers across both commercial and government markets. Looking ahead, we remain committed to disciplined execution as we work toward achieving profitability and creating long-term value for our shareholders."


**Third Quarter Financial Results**


Revenue for the third quarter of 2026 was $2.7 million, representing an increase of 84% on a sequential basis and an increase of 36% compared to the prior year period. This improvement was driven by the first full quarter of revenue contributions from the recent VigilAigent acquisition and the State of Texas contract.


The gross profit margin was 55% for the third quarter of 2026, compared to 66% for the second quarter of 2026 and 77% for the prior year period. The decrease primarily reflects changes in revenue and product mix, including the addition of lower-margin managed services revenue from VigilAigent.


Operating expense for the third quarter of 2026 was $4.3 million, an increase of $0.8 million sequentially and $0.6 million compared to the third quarter of 2025. VigilAigent contributed approximately $0.8 million of operating expenses. Excluding VigilAigent, operating expenses from legacy Intrusion operations decreased approximately $0.2 million, or 5%, year over year. The Company also implemented reductions in headcount, contractor and discretionary marketing spending, and exchanged a portion of management and Board cash compensation for equity to conserve cash.


Net loss attributable to Intrusion for the third quarter of 2026 was $2.9 million, or $(0.12) per share, compared to a net loss of $2.1 million, or $(0.10) per share, in the third quarter of 2025. The increase primarily reflects higher operating expenses and a $0.4 million increase in interest expense related to the Company's notes payable.


As of September 30, 2026, cash and cash equivalents were $0.4 million.


On October 29, 2026, the Company exchanged $4.0 million of outstanding debt for Series B preferred stock. This transaction, together with a recently completed warrant inducement transaction and the sale of a limited number of shares through the Company's at-the-market (ATM) facility, increased stockholders' equity to more than $5.0 million. As a result, the Company satisfied Nasdaq's applicable listing requirements and qualified for an additional 180-day extension to regain compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement.

The call will also be webcast live ([LINK](https://pr.report/ti7u) ) For those unable to participate in the live conference call, a replay will be accessible beginning tonight at 7:00 P.M. EST until November 26, 2026, by dialing 1-877-481-4010, or 1-919-882-2331 for international callers, and entering the following access code: 54609. Additionally, a live and archived audio webcast of the conference call will be available at[www.intrusion.com](https://pr.report/ti7v) .


**About Intrusion Inc.**


Intrusion Inc. is a cybersecurity company based in Plano, Texas, specializing in advanced threat intelligence. At the core of its capabilities is a proprietary database that catalogs the historical behavior, associations, and reputational risk of IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, domain names, and hostnames. Built on years of gathering global internet intelligence and supporting government entities, this data forms the backbone of Intrusion's commercial solutions. In 2026, Intrusion acquired VigilAigent, an AI-native managed security service provider, expanding its recurring revenue base and commercial reach.
